Karnataka seeks national disaster tag for drought

Karnataka's Deputy Chief Minister Dr G Parameshwara has requested the central government to declare the state's worsening drought a national disaster. The state government is seeking this designation due to the severity of the drought conditions impacting the region. The request highlights the critical situation faced by Karnataka.
